note: Machine-readable coupling index. Each concern is one logical thing mirrored across N files that must stay in sync. checks[] are mechanically greppable; semantic_coupling[] are curated sync obligations that cannot be mechanically checked. The checker (coupling_check.py) FAILS when a mirror diverges from source_of_truth — first run is EXPECTED to fail on known-unfixed drift (that is the point: surface staleness, do not hide it).

concerns.title: P2P wire magic bytes must have a single source of truth
concerns.reason: Four divergent magic-byte sets coexist. Only protocol.rs is read by the live wire path (NetworkConfig::magic_bytes). The other three sets disagree with it and with each other; any code path or second implementation reading the wrong set silently fails handshakes.

checks.note: lib.rs Network::magic_bytes() is dead and diverges from wire
NetworkParams testnet magic diverges from wire
NetworkParams regtest magic diverges from wire

semantic_coupling: btpc-core/src/lib.rs NETWORK_MAGIC_* constants and Network::magic_bytes() are written-but-never-read (dead config) — delete or delegate to protocol::BTPC_*_MAGIC
btpc-core/src/blockchain/mod.rs NetworkParams.magic_bytes field is dead config — delete or delegate to protocol
btpc-core/src/economics/constants.rs NetworkConstants.magic is consumed only by its own tests — dead

concerns.title: P2P default ports must have a single source of truth
concerns.reason: NetworkParams (blockchain/mod.rs) still carries Bitcoin's ports (8333/18333/18444) while the live network listens on 18341/18351/18361. README example uses 8333 too.
semantic_coupling: btpc-core/src/network/mod.rs NetworkConfig::mainnet/testnet/regtest hardcode 18341/18351/18361 — should read economics::constants::*_PORT instead of duplicating the literals

concerns.title: Block reward formula must have a single implementation
concerns.reason: The linear-decay reward formula is implemented 4x; editing one silently leaves the rest stale (consensus-critical).
semantic_coupling: calculate_block_reward defined 4x: btpc-core/src/blockchain/mod.rs:220, btpc-core/src/economics/rewards.rs:24, btpc-core/src/consensus/rewards.rs:16, src-tauri/src/embedded_node.rs:3309
Only consensus/rewards.rs goes through ConsensusParams; the others hardcode economics::constants. Delegate all call sites to one impl.

concerns.title: Difficulty adjustment must have a single implementation
concerns.reason: The desktop embedded node re-derives difficulty (LWMA, fast-adjustment, EDA blending) alongside the core difficulty module.
semantic_coupling: src-tauri/src/embedded_node.rs calculate_next_difficulty / calculate_lwma_difficulty / calculate_fast_adjustment / blend_difficulty duplicate btpc-core/src/consensus/difficulty.rs
EDA tier constants (900/1200/1800s) live in btpc-core/src/consensus/mod.rs constants and are consumed by the embedded node — must stay equal

concerns.title: Two sync systems must not silently diverge
concerns.reason: Legacy SyncManager (network/sync.rs) is still live in bins/btpc_node; IntegratedSyncManager is the hardened path. Deleting or changing one without the other risks a second divergent sync.
semantic_coupling: btpc-core/src/network/sync.rs SyncManager is used only by bins/btpc_node/src/main.rs — legacy; migrate to IntegratedSyncManager or document why it must stay
specs/003-testnet-p2p-hardening/tasks.md T056/T118 note sync.rs:75-88 should delegate to IntegratedSyncManager
